outcome: Maternal mental health in the postnatal period
cohort: 6 pregnant women with bipolar disorder (5 women) or major depression (1 woman) treated with lamotrigine
finding: Lamotrigine treatment during pregnancy in women with bipolar disorder or major depression was associated with no maternal psychiatric hospitalizations and generally positive pregnancy outcomes, although further research is needed to confirm these findings.
mod_finding: Two women underwent lower segment cesarean section, while the other four had induced labor.
birth_weight: Two babies had low birth weight
